_about: Every public-domain Charles Hodge (1797-1878, Princeton) text the Word Hoard holds. The Systematic Theology (3 vols + index), the Ephesians commentary and What is Darwinism? are held clean from CCEL. The Romans and Corinthians commentaries, The Way of Life and four collections of essays, discourses and church history are raw Internet Archive OCR. Gutenberg has only What is Darwinism? (PG 19192), which CCEL already supplies. Not A. A. Hodge, his son, whose books are not shelved here.

hodge-ephesians: A Commentary on the Epistle to the Ephesians (1856)

hodge-romans-1864: Commentary on the Epistle to the Romans (revised edition, 1864)
hodge-1-corinthians-1857: An Exposition of the First Epistle to the Corinthians (1857)
hodge-way-of-life-1841: The Way of Life (Philadelphia: American Sunday-School Union, 1841)
hodge-essays-reviews-1857: Essays and Reviews, selected from the Princeton Review (1857)
hodge-conference-papers-1879: Conference Papers: Analyses of Discourses, Doctrinal and Practical (1879)
hodge-constitutional-history-1851: The Constitutional History of the Presbyterian Church in the United States of America (1851 edition)
hodge-2-corinthians-1860: An Exposition of the Second Epistle to the Corinthians (1860)
